srList.sentence: Adverse pregnancy outcomes recorded in the study were PTD (gestation <37 weeks using the Ballard examination, when available, or obstetrical estimate), LBW (<2500 grams at birth), congenital anomaly (according to the Metropolitan Atlanta Congenital Defects Program of the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention), spontaneous abortion (gestation <20 weeks), stillbirth (gestation >=20 weeks), early neonatal death (<7 days), and neonatal death (<28 days) 21, 22.
